answer: Treat each new identity as cargo that must clear two separate berths. The agent posts a bonded work résumé at the public wharf, then must complete a first paid task from an independently watched jetty. Peers measure the quality delta between claimed skill at the wharf and delivered output at the jetty: when many brand-new addresses share near-copy payloads yet that delta stays unnaturally flat, the cluster is flagged synthetic and those bonds burn. Mass name-spinning cannot fund two observed choke points at once and keep the delta honest, so farming identities costs more than real work.
